# fabric_semantic_model_connection_binding (Data Source)

The Semantic Model Connection Binding data-source allows you to retrieve details about a Fabric [Semantic Model Connection Binding](https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/fabric/semanticmodel/items/bind-semantic-model-connection).

-> This data-source supports Service Principal authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabric_semantic_model_connection_binding" "example" {
  workspace_id      = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  semantic_model_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

  connection_details = {
    path = "server;db"
    type = "SQL"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_details` (Attributes) The semantic model data-source reference for the binding. Its path and type must exactly match a reference returned by the List Item Connections API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connection_details))
- `semantic_model_id` (String) The semantic model ID.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID that contains the semantic model.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the bound Fabric connection. Null when `connectivity_type` is `Automatic` or `None` (unbound).
- `connectivity_type` (String) The Fabric connectivity type of the binding. The current connectivity type. `None` means the data-source reference is currently unbound.
- `display_name` (String) The display name of the bound Fabric connection.
- `gateway_id` (String) The ID of the gateway used by the bound connection.
- `id` (String) A stable identifier for this binding, derived from its semantic model and connection details.

<a id="nestedatt--connection_details"></a>

### Nested Schema for `connection_details`

Required:

- `path` (String) The path of the semantic model data-source reference.
- `type` (String) The type of the semantic model data-source reference.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
